name: Pole of Collapsing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A 10-ft pole that collapses into a 1-ft rod.
text: While holding this 10-foot pole, you can take a Utilize action to collapse it into a 1-foot-long rod, for ease of storage. The pole's weight doesn't change. You can use another Utilize action to extend it again. (No other effect in the game.)
